}}'''Ronan''' is the ''[[shambayan]]'' of the [[Fal Dara]] keep in [[Shienar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ronan}}

==History==
Ronan is age-withered and has few responsibilities besides ceremonies and acting as secretary to [[Agelmar Jagad]].

His female counterpart and supposed equal, [[Elansu]] the ''[[shatayan]]'', handles most of the keep administration.

==Appearance==
He is age-withered and tall with a snow-white top-knot.

==Activities==
Many years ago he and twenty men held the Jehaan Tower against a thousand trollocs.

He conducts the welcome for the [[Amyrlin Seat]] when she arrives at Fal Dara keep.{{ref/book|2|2}}

He is killed when the Horn of Valere is stolen.{{ref/book|2|6}}
